basics.summary: Doctoral Researcher in Machine Learning at Bielefeld University. PhD in Machine Learning, dissertation submitted September 2026, defence expected December 2026. Research focus: generative AI and reinforcement learning for neural architecture search, anomaly & out-of-distribution detection, AutoML, graph neural networks, and robust/uncertainty-aware methods.
